note: Utah teapot (Newell 1975, Blinn's squashed proportions) dressed with the Taotie Kit; a showpiece, not a museum object. Size chosen: spout tip -> handle back 240 mm on the undecorated surface (37.30 mm per Newell unit). The form itself is proved against three.js TeapotGeometry by reference/utah-teapot/check-form.mjs (< 0.2 mm); these ratios only check that the build keeps that frame: spout tip at Newell x 3.434, handle back at x -3.0 plus its 1.5 mm back band, knob top 117.5 mm plus the 2.1 mm whorl, body standing on y 0, belly diameter 149.2 (r 2.0 Newell units, relief faded to 0 at the +-X seams). Parts: body (all body registers + inner wall), lid (dome, knob, skirt), spout (tube, lip, bore), handles (tube), flanges (2 body + 2 lid), heads (the ram head biting the handle).
